headline: Ratchet & Clank matches bomb behaviour, elevators and menu routines
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 97.71% to 97.91%, with 5,064 of 5,124 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The new work covers bomb updates, elevator partner spawning, menu slots and hardware setup.
highlights: #106 matches the elevator partner-spawn routine shared by Novalis, Rilgar and Pokitaru.
Pause descriptions and Trespasser rings retain complete texture information for the native port.
The pause stream-buffer allocator lands alongside display setup and menu-cache search.
A staged near miss remains separate from the landed implementations.
